_grading.operationalization: FIRED := the photo-editing Skill tool is invoked in the fresh-session stream-json transcript. SILENT := no such invocation. Behavioral signature recorded as corroboration.
_grading.fire_signature: The three laws are visible: dimensions/bounds measured by tool (inspect script or PIL/identify) before the edit, output written to a NEW file with the original byte-identical afterward (hash compare), and the result viewed/verified against the ask before delivery.
_grading.silent_signature: Direct answer or ordinary work without edit ceremony for non-editing turns (factual questions, image GENERATION requests, charts).
_grading.surface: Claude Code headless (claude -p), project or personal scope
_grading.gate: 2 runs per prompt: >=83% of should-fire runs fire (>=7/8); >=5/6 should-not runs stay silent
